en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural spring scene with blossoming orchard trees. In the foreground a farmer with a hat stands beside a horse hitched to a simple plow on freshly worked soil. A wooden ladder leans against a tree, and in the background a path or road runs behind the orchard where two women in light dresses are walking. The printed caption in red German text at the upper left reads "Cossebaude. Partie in der Baumblut."
